meta.title: POS for retail and restaurants: interactive demo
meta.description: Point-of-sale demo with sample data from Colombia: sell with a barcode scanner, a scale or by table with kitchen tickets, take split payments, issue a sample electronic POS document, keep selling offline and close the till with X and Z reports. Includes a multi-store console with inventory and transfers.

demoPos.pageSubtitle: Sell with a barcode scanner and a scale, or by table with kitchen tickets. Take split payments, issue the electronic POS document, keep selling offline and close the till with a Z report. Everything works on this page.
demoPos.sampleHint: The businesses (Mercado La Ceiba and Fogón Andino), their tax IDs, stores, addresses, employees, customers, ID numbers, phone numbers, barcodes, stock and figures are made up.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything is calculated in your browser: stock per store, taxes included in prices (19% VAT, 5% VAT, exempt or 8% consumption tax), points, change, tips, kitchen tickets, X and Z reports, cash count, commissions and the store console. Your sales and changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.scanner: The “Scan” field accepts a real barcode scanner connected as a keyboard (USB or Bluetooth); if you don't have one, use the sample codes.
howItWorks.simulated: Simulated: sending the document to the DIAN (the CUDE is computed here with SHA-384, in test mode, and never leaves your browser), the card terminal, QR payments, the scale, printer and cash drawer, and sending the receipt by WhatsApp or email. The “Offline” button is a demo switch: it does not cut your connection.
howItWorks.project: In your project, the till installs as an app on a tablet or PC, stores sales on the device when the internet goes down and syncs them when it comes back, issues the electronic document through your authorized technology provider and connects to your card terminal, thermal printer, scanner, cash drawer and scale.

steps.1: Retail: press “Scan”, use a sample code and weigh a per-kilo product with “Read scale”.
steps.2: In the ticket, look up customer 300 123 4567, redeem 500 points and take a split payment: part cash, the rest by card or QR.
steps.3: Turn on “Offline”, make another sale (it is queued) and reconnect to see it sync.
steps.4: Restaurant: open a table in “Tables”, take the order with modifiers, send it to the kitchen and move the ticket forward in “Kitchen (KDS)”.
steps.5: In “X/Z reports” review sales by payment method and close the shift with a cash count; in “Stores” move stock between stores.
